metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.
Unique identifier for the analytics rule.

properties.displayName: Attempt to Create Wrapped or Obfuscated SQL Object - SecurityEvent
properties.description: Detects SQL Server Audit event 33205 records ingested into SecurityEvent when a user attempts to create or alter a stored procedure, function, view, or trigger using WITH ENCRYPTION. This SQL Server option obfuscates the stored module definition. The rule also recognizes an explicit WRAPPED marker and reports successful and failed attempts.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventSourceName =~ "MSSQLSERVER" and EventID == 33205
| extend RawEventData = tostring(EventData)
| extend ParsedEventData = trim(" ", replace_regex(replace_regex(RawEventData, @"<[^>]+>", " "), @"\s+", " "))
| extend RawSqlStatement = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<Statement>(.*?)</Statement>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)statement(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bstatement\s*[=:]\s*(.*?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend SqlStatement = trim(" ", replace_regex(RawSqlStatement, @"\s+", " "))
| where SqlStatement matches regex @"(?i)(?:^|;)\s*(?:CREATE\s+(?:OR\s+ALTER\s+)?|ALTER\s+)(?:PROC(?:EDURE)?|FUNCTION|VIEW|TRIGGER)\b.*\b(?:WITH\s+ENCRYPTION|WRAPPED)\b"
| extend ActionAttempted = toupper(extract(@"(?i)(?:^|;)\s*(CREATE|ALTER)", 1, SqlStatement))
| extend ObjectType = toupper(extract(@"(?i)(?:^|;)\s*(?:CREATE\s+(?:OR\s+ALTER\s+)?|ALTER\s+)(PROC(?:EDURE)?|FUNCTION|VIEW|TRIGGER)\b", 1, SqlStatement))
| extend ObjectType = iff(ObjectType == "PROC", "PROCEDURE", ObjectType)
| extend ObfuscationMethod = case(
    SqlStatement matches regex @"(?i)\bWITH\s+ENCRYPTION\b", "WITH ENCRYPTION",
    SqlStatement matches regex @"(?i)\bWRAPPED\b", "WRAPPED",
    "UNKNOWN")
| extend AuditSucceeded = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<Succeeded>(.*?)</Succeeded>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)succeeded(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bsucceeded\s*[=:]\s*(false|true|0|1)\b", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend DatabaseUser = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ServerPrincipalName>(.*?)</ServerPrincipalName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<SessionServerPrincipalName>(.*?)</SessionServerPrincipalName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)(?:server_principal_name|session_server_principal_name)(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\b(?:server_principal_name|session_server_principal_name)\s*[=:]\s*([^;]+?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend DatabaseName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<DatabaseName>(.*?)</DatabaseName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)database_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bdatabase_name\s*[=:]\s*([^;]+?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend SchemaName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<SchemaName>(.*?)</SchemaName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)schema_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bschema_name\s*[=:]\s*([^;]+?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend ObjectName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ObjectName>(.*?)</ObjectName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)object_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)(?:PROC(?:EDURE)?|FUNCTION|VIEW|TRIGGER)\s+([^\s(]+)", 1, SqlStatement))
| extend SourceClient = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ClientIp>(.*?)</ClientIp>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)client_ip(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bclient_ip\s*[=:]\s*([^; ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend ApplicationName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ApplicationName>(.*?)</ApplicationName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)application_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bapplication_name\s*[=:]\s*(.*?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend DatabaseHost = Computer
| extend SourceIpAddress = extract(@"((?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}|[0-9A-Fa-f:]{2,})", 1, SourceClient)
| extend SqlStatement = substring(SqlStatement, 0, 4000)
| project TimeGenerated, DatabaseUser, DatabaseName, SchemaName, ObjectName, ObjectType, ActionAttempted, ObfuscationMethod, AuditSucceeded, DatabaseHost, SourceClient, SourceIpAddress, ApplicationName, SqlStatement, Computer, EventID, EventSourceName, Activity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Obfuscated SQL object attempt by {{DatabaseUser}} on {{DatabaseHost}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: SQL user {{DatabaseUser}} attempted to create or alter obfuscated object {{ObjectName}} on {{DatabaseHost}}. Review the action result, object type, SQL statement, source client, and application.
